messages:
maria_csm: quick async standup for EmberBank renewal — we've got a spike of failing webhook deliveries that's affecting the renewal demo. TL;DR: what I did / blockers / today:

maria_csm: did triage with support, confirmed 5 customers seeing 502s on webhook endpoint since 03:20 UTC

natalie_support: logged all customer request IDs in Zendesk and filed jira CS-4821. Some payloads contain large attachments (>1MB) which may be triggering upstream timeouts.

aj_eng: looking. I saw repeated 502s in the gateway logs, stacking at the rate limiter. PR for a backoff/retry fix in flight: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/789 (staging green)

tyler_se: ping @aj_eng can you include request-id header in logs? I need it for tracing into the runtime cache layer.

aj_eng: yes adding header now, deploying to staging in ~5m. patch: `add req-id -> X-Req-Id`

incidents-bot: Incident created — INC-2026 — webhook_delivery_surge — priority: high — commander: aj_eng

sam_csm: renewal call scheduled 2026-04-03 16:00 UTC with EmberBank execs. We need a mitigation before then or clear rollback plan.

maria_csm: blocker: EmberBank will cancel the demo if errors persist. Also need confirmation on data retention for private deployment question raised during last call.

aj_eng: mitigation plan: (1) enable 10s ingress timeout fallback for EmberBank route, (2) enable request-level retries with 2s jitter, (3) monitor errors for 30m, rollback if >1% error rate. Doing step 1->2 now.

tyler_se: FYI I queued a quick CR review for aj's PR, small nits only. @maria_csm once staging looks stable can you run the demo flow (steps below) and paste the first failing request-id if any?

maria_csm: will run demo flow at 15:35 UTC and report. Steps: 1) create demo payload -> `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.io/webhook/... -d @demo.json -H 'x-cust: emberbank'` 2) watch delivery in support console

natalie_support: repro steps saved to ticket CS-4821, I've attached the failing webhook body and sample logs.

aj_eng: deployed to staging. watch logs: `kubectl logs deploy/gateway -f | grep emberbank`

maria_csm: staging run: 2 successful, 1 502 — request-id `req-0a9b` — sending log excerpt in a follow-up message. :exclamation:

tyler_se: got the req-id, tracing now. looks like backend connection pool saturated — increasing pool to 50 for EmberBank route as a hotfix.

aj_eng: hotfix applied to staging. can anyone run the demo again?

sam_csm: I can join if needed. Please @me when production plan is ready. :thumbsup:

maria_csm: re-run at 15:50 UTC — all green so far, will continue monitoring. I'll update the renewal notes and set expectation with EmberBank leaders.

natalie_support: I'll close the Zendesk alerts if production stays stable for 1 hour.

aj_eng: next steps: PR to master with headers+retry+pool adjustments, release window request for prod at 17:30 UTC if QA passes. tagging eng oncall.

maria_csm: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for the demo. ping me if you need anything else.
